purpose: Manual behavior-evaluation cases; these are not an automated model benchmark.

cases.prompt: I just cloned this unfamiliar monorepo. Explain how to understand it before I start a small API change.
expected_behaviors: Read repository instructions and manifests first
Identify entry points, tests, and key data flow

cases.prompt: There is no useful README. Map the service and tell me the safest first command to run.
expected_behaviors: Inspect available code and configuration evidence
Suggest a safe minimal command and note uncertainties

cases.prompt: Please orient yourself in this repo; I have uncommitted work.
expected_behaviors: Inspect status and diffs before edits
